reviewer.name: Codex independent Houhanshu 031 round-two date-repair reviewer

summary: Rejected. The sealed candidate correctly identifies the Yuanhe tomb worship in s0085 as posthumous, and it removes only claim-177. However, it leaves claims 173–176 attributed to undated s0001 even though the fresh independent audit identifies their dated local contexts elsewhere in the chapter and requires their re-anchoring. The one-operation proposal therefore does not resolve every finding it claims to repair and cannot proceed to host curation.
